excludedAnchors.hall1: The pixel pick is right: it is the centre of the red oval roof (segmented roof centroid 1942, 2592). The model's Hall 1 envelope is the problem: it is about 95 m long where the roof on the image is about 125 m, and it sits in the southern part of the real footprint, so its centre lands about 20 m from the image centre. Fitting it would pull the CC, Hall 14 and Hall 6 several metres off, so it is kept as a check only.
